newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to refrain from open market operations on Tuesday, market analysts said.

"We're looking for no Fed even though funds are trading above target," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone & McCarthy Research Associates Inc. "Nothing the Fed does at 1130 (EDT) has any implications for the FOMC meeting later."
Some analysts said there was a possibility of a reserve addition via overnight system repurchase agreements.
At 1030 EDT/1430 GMT, fed funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
